accessibility.evidence: a11y-architect audit (12 findings) addressed: accent darkened to #7c3aed (white text 5.7:1, focus ring 3.1-3.4:1), form borders via --field-line (>=3.4:1 dark, >=3.6:1 light), checked format segment filled with accent, per-group radiogroups, document.title + focus moved to h1 on navigation (verified in Chrome: 'Downloads · OpenTakez', heading focused), progress announcements limited to state changes via role=status, scroll-padding for fixed dock, labels separated from hints, token dialog autofocus. Not done: no automated axe run.

responsive.evidence: Rendered at 390x844 (dark and light, mobile+touch emulation) and 1280x800 (light). Phone: link dock fixed above tab bar, nothing overlaps; desktop: centered 40rem column, nav in header, dock above content. Long URL in the input truncates within the field.

loading.evidence: Job queued state with indeterminate stripe and 'Wartet …' rendered (390x844-progress.png); resolve skeleton has fixed 16:9 size.

empty.evidence: History empty state 'Fertige Downloads erscheinen hier.' rendered (390x844-light-empty.png).

error.evidence: Playwright mobile 390x844: 400 unsupported site shows translated message in role=alert, 422 shows server detail. Not captured as screenshot.

partial.evidence: Playwright mobile 390x844: expired history item shows 'No longer on the server' with 'Download again'. Missing-thumbnail placeholder is implemented but was not rendered in a test.

success.evidence: Done state with Save button rendered against the real backend in Docker (390x844-docker-done.png).

permission.evidence: Token dialog opens for a protected server with no token, focus in the field (390x844-light-permission.png); wrong/right token flows covered by Playwright.
